description: This file defines a PHP class 'TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' that listens to module status change events within the OrangeHRM dashboard system. It subscribes to status change events for the 'time' module and updates widget permissions accordingly.

classes.name: TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling status change events of the 'time' module in OrangeHRM dashboard, updating widget permissions based on module status.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the module status change event.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event; if the previous module was 'time', updates the dashboard time widget permissions.
